scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs && npm run build:d.ts
scripts.build:scala: wget -q -O data/scales.zip http://huygens-fokker.org/docs/scales.zip && unzip -o data/scales.zip -d data/ && for f in data/scl/*; do iconv -f iso-8859-1 -t utf-8 "$f" -o "$f"; done
scripts.build:sagittals: wget -q -O data/sagittals.ods https://sagittal.org/Sagittal-SMuFL-Map.ods && soffice --headless --convert-to csv:"Text - txt - csv (StarCalc)":44,34,76 data/sagittals.ods --outdir data/ && src/build/accidentals/sagittals.py data/sagittals.csv > data/sagittals.json
scripts.build:smufl: jq -s -f src/build/accidentals/merge_smufl_sagittals.jq data/ranges.json data/sagittals.json data/smufl.json | sponge data/smufl.json
scripts.build:full: npm run build && npm run build:chords && npm run build:scala && npm run build:sagittals && npm run build:smufl
scripts.test: npm run test:lint && npm run test:ts && npm run test:js
